description:
Creates a single material in the company and adds it to the current project.
            
`name` and `uom_name` are required, and both are immutable once the material exists.
The combination of `name` and `uom_name` must be unique within the company; a conflicting
request returns 409 and the error carries the id of the existing material in `data.existing_material_id`.
            
When the matching material is in the current project's recycle bin, it is restored instead; when it exists in
the company but not in the current project, it is added to the project instead. Both return 200 with the
existing material. A non-empty `description` replaces the stored description; all other fields of the existing
material are kept. Only a match that is active in the current project returns 409.
            
To create or update in bulk, keyed on `origin_id`, use `PATCH .../materials/sync` instead.

schema.description: Request body for creating a single material.

name.description:
The name of this material. Immutable once created.
Must be unique within the company in combination with uom_name.

uom_name.description:
The unit of measure name for this material. Immutable once created.
A new unit of measure is created if one with this name does not already exist.

weight.description: The weight of this material. Must be zero or greater.
